description: Add a rule for an email address or a whole domain and return it (id, kind, direction, pattern). Block rules are enforced server-side for every inbox in the tenant: matching senders are refused on receive and matching recipients are refused on send. Allow rules are recorded for reference and are not enforced as exceptions. Errors: 400 invalid kind or pattern.

direction.description: Where the rule applies: inbound (receiving), outbound (sending) or both. Default both.

kind.description: block to refuse mail matching the pattern; allow to record an allow-listed address.

pattern.description: Full email address ("someone@example.com") or bare domain ("example.com", which matches every address at that domain). Case-insensitive.

name: add_address_rule
title: Add allow/block rule
